name: plugin-maintainer
description: Keeps the installed plugins honest against this plugins repo: checks that every installed plugin has the source version and is file-for-file identical to a fresh build, that the local default branch matches origin, and reports it as a table, with notes for source plugins that are not installed and older same-named copies from other sources. Read-only. Use when asked whether the plugins are up to date, stale or out of sync with the repo.
